Subject: Request: embargo exception + logo use for pilot announcement

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for a great kickoff yesterday — the pilot results look promising and our comms team is eager to include Redwood in our partner callout when we publicize next week's announcement. Two quick asks: 

1) We plan to publish a short press release on Dec 1. Our legal is asking whether Redwood can agree to a narrow publicity carve-out so we can name Redwood and include your logo in the public release.

2) We want to share a co-branded webinar banner in the email blast on Nov 28 (before the contract becomes effective on Dec 5). Is it possible to get written permission for pre-effective logo usage? If not, would a signed amendment or a one-off written approval work?

I've attached the draft press release for context. If we can get a short set of acceptable redlines or a one-paragraph approval for logo use, that would help our timeline.

Elena
Elena Morris

Kim / Laura — forwarding Novarun's ask. TL;DR: they want to name Redwood and use our logo in an email banner on Nov 28 and in a press release on Dec 1; contract effective date is Dec 5.

Questions for legal (Kim): what is acceptable here vs risk? My read: a limited, revocable pre-effective permission tied to review/approval of the final release + narrow quote approval window could work. We should avoid any perpetual license language.

Laura — if we can agree to a one-off co-branded banner (webinar promo) before effective date, what assets/guidelines do you need?

Can you both weigh in today? Novarun is on a tight comms schedule.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber

jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

Jonas — thanks for flagging. Quick legal perspective after a read of the draft: 

- We can offer a limited, revocable publicity permission and a narrow logo license for marketing materials tied to the pilot. The permission must be conditional on:
  * Redwood approval of the final release and any assets ("Approval" -- no implied endorsement).
  * Use only of the provided logo pack and adherence to Redwood brand guidelines.
  * A clear time box: permission expires 30 days after the contract effective date (i.e., until Jan 4, 2026) unless mutually extended in writing.
  * No transfer / sublicense: Novarun cannot grant third parties the right to use the logo.
  * Quote approval: Redwood must approve any Redwood-attributed quote in writing (we can provide a 48-hour review window).

- For the pre-effective webinar banner (Nov 28), we can grant one-off written permission if Novarun provides the final banner and commit to the approval process (we'll need 24-48 hours). This is preferable to signing an amendment immediately — saves time.

- Contract redlines: add a short publicity carve-out to the Order Form referencing the standard publicity section in the MSA, plus a one-paragraph amendment for the pre-effective permission (or we can do a DocuSign one-off approval that they sign). I will draft suggested language below and attach a redline.

Suggested language (for Order Form addendum):
"Redwood grants Customer a revocable, non-exclusive license to use Redwood's name and logo solely for the purpose of promotional materials directly related to the Pilot, subject to Redwood's prior written approval of the final assets and any quoted materials. This permission is expressly limited in time and scope and may be withdrawn at Redwood's discretion"

I'll attach a marked-up Order Form and a short one-off approval template.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Jonas / Kim — marketing here. Happy to support. Two operational notes: 

1) I'll send our logo pack and the quick-do's-and-don'ts (clear space, color usage). Please instruct Novarun to use the horizontal logo + white-space and not to recolor.

2) For the webinar banner on Nov 28: we'll do a fast-track review — we need the final banner by EOD Nov 26 to guarantee a 48-hour review. If they miss that, approval may slip.

3) We prefer to host the final co-branded banner on our CDN for the first 7 days where possible (reduces risk of uncontrolled variations).

I'll attach the zipped assets now.

— Laura

Thanks Jonas, Kim, Laura — appreciate the clear options and speed. Novarun is okay with the 30-day timebox and quote approval process. A couple follow-ups: 

- On the co-branded webinar: Novarun team prefers to publish the email on Nov 28; we'll prioritize getting the final banner to you by Nov 26 EOD.
- We have a separate marketing activity: a co-branded webinar landing page that might go live Nov 25. Would the same one-off written approval cover that, or would you need a separate approval per asset?

If we can get the one-off written approval template Kim mentioned (we're happy to sign), that will let our operations team move forward while you finalize the Order Form amendment.

I'll send the final banner and landing page mockups later today.

Elena
